display_only: Display only: nothing here opens, sizes, stops or closes trades.

card_formulas.defense: worst drawdown of the non-compounded equity curve (size x net margin %), last 30d: 100% -> 40, 10% -> 99
card_formulas.consistency: share of the last 8 weeks with positive net USD: 0 -> 40, 100% -> 99
card_formulas.discipline: share of closes, last 30d, that exited by a rule stop (trail / TD / SL / BE / live stop sync) rather than manual, gate violation or liquidation: 85% -> 40, 100% -> 99
card_formulas.iq: share of Soft/Ideology + OPT7 changes tested that beat replay (OPT7_GATE + IDEA_SCORES keep): 0 -> 40, 100% -> 99

takeover_live.rule: meter = last-20 expectancy: -20% -> empty, +40% -> full; Takeover = last 10 closes >= 60% wins and net $ > 0

rep.map: Rookie = survive, Starter = consistent, Veteran = go_big, Legend = $1,000 goal. Level 1-5 = share of next-phase gates met.
